android.desc:
Omnitweety receives share intent from any app, and if it contains a URL, then it tries to fetch its title and then re-share it to the app of your choice.


Features include:
- When you want to share URL to other apps, just select Omnitweety from share feature of the app. Omnitweety will automatically tweet with a predefined template.
- Template can be edited(prefix/suffix)
- If you want to post with a comment, click the pencil button popped up when you select Omnitweety from share feature.
- In case a browser or app does not provide URL's title, Omnitweety can automatically fetch url by itself.


Omnitweety needs Overlay Permission in order to display buttons over other apps. Upon the first launch, the app will request Overlay Permission. please follow the instruction and grant the Overlay Permission.
